reply: According to the document, a bill must be presented to the President before taking effect [3], and if disapproved by him, it can be repassed by two-thirds of both Houses [3]. Additionally, if a bill is not returned within ten days (excluding Sundays) after being presented, it becomes law unless Congress adjourns in which case it may still be vetoed upon the President's request to reconsider it or pass it with concurrence from both houses [1][3].
